definition: At t use known peer adoption status and growth at t-1. No adopters =>0 only with all 10 histories known. All 10 adopters => compare median growth with focal growth. Otherwise compare adopter and nonadopter medians. At least 80% macro coverage per group.
reference: Supplied Koning et al. 2018, learning definition and edge-case notes. Complete histories required for primary; no unknown policy recoded as zero.
emulation_limit: Language-share proxy, not Berry administrative distance.
source_dates: Reviewed phase calendar. Published complete-topic ESG benchmark remains separate.
